title: Orbit Club — Make a little universe
description: A vivid, responsive Three.js planetary playground with animated orbital paths, drag/pinch orbit controls, zoom, selectable planet field notes, pause/resume, simulation-speed control, reset, and a readable WebGL fallback.

tests.name: HTML entry contract
tests.command: Node assertion that index.html contains exactly one <script type="module" src="./main.js"></script> and no other script elements

tests.name: Local Vite bundle check
tests.command: vite.build({ configFile: false, root: process.cwd(), logLevel: 'warn', build: { write: false } })
tests.outcome: PASS; emitted assets/index-ETeHNChP.js, assets/index-CMSUxNPH.css, and index.html in memory

tests.name: Worker report validation
tests.command: Node JSON.parse and required-field assertions for worker-report.json

repairsMade: Paused axial planet rotation whenever the simulation is paused, in addition to freezing orbital motion.
Removed an empty CSS import and lowered the mobile experience minimum height to 520px.
Guarded camera positioning so reset and zoom controls do not throw if WebGL initialization fails.
knownLimitations: Motion, scale, and planet field notes are playful approximations rather than scientifically precise ephemerides; the interface labels the scene as stylized and not to scale.

Browser interaction and visual rendering were not tested because the supplied prompt says localhost browser access is unavailable; the WebGL fallback was validated by source review, not runtime browser testing.
